أدويتي مشروع صيدلاني سعودي وُلد عند شبّا: Adwiyati is a Saudi pharmacy project born at the pharmacy counter, out of a hardship that repeats every season: a guest who has travelled from afar, holding a medicine whose instructions they cannot read.
المعاناة التي جئنا لننهيها: The hardship we set out to end
ضيفٌ يقف أمام علبة دواء لا يقرأ منها حرف: A guest standing before a medicine box they cannot read a single letter of.
جرعةٌ تُؤخذ بالتخمين، لأن التعليمات لم ت: A dose taken by guesswork, because the instructions were not understood.
ضيفٌ يخجل أن يسأل مرة ثانية، فيغادر وهو: A guest too shy to ask a second time, who leaves worried.
ألّا تقف اللغة بين ضيف الرحمن ودوائه، في: That language never stands between a Guest of Allah and their medicine, so that every pilgrim performs their rites at peace about their health.
نُنهي معاناة الحجاج والمعتمرين مع تعليما: To end the hardship of Hajj and Umrah pilgrims with medicine instructions they cannot understand, by enabling pharmacies to speak to every guest in their own language.
ملصقٌ يقرؤه بلغته: كم يأخذ، ومتى، وإلى م: A label they read in their language: how much to take, when, and for how long.
مقطعٌ يشاهده بلغته، أو بلغة الإشارة لضيو: A video they watch in their language, or in sign language for our Deaf guests.
وصيدليٌّ يتحقق ويشرح، ولا يغادر الضيف إل: And a pharmacist who checks and explains, so no guest leaves without peace of mind.
خدمة الضيف شرف: Serving the guest is an honour
نرى في كل حاج ومعتمر ضيفاً للرحمن، وخدمت: We see every pilgrim as a Guest of Allah; serving them is an honour before it is a job.
كل ضيف يستحق أن يفهم دواءه بلغته، أياً ك: Every guest deserves to understand their medicine in their own language, whatever it is, including sign language.
كل كلمة مراجَعة، وكل ملصق يمر بعين الصيد: Every word is reviewed and every label passes before the pharmacist's eye, because the guest's health is a trust in our hands.
نرفع عن الضيف الحيرة والحرج، ونحفظ خصوصي: We spare the guest confusion and embarrassment, and protect their privacy: nothing is printed except what their medicine needs.
